subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: While interviewing, the skill shall put questions to the operator one at a time, and every question shall carry a recommended answer with its reasoning.
rationale: batched questions bewilder; a recommendation turns each into a cheap confirm/redirect; one-at-a-time is a quality bar (the fit criterion), recommendation coverage is absolute
fit_criterion: across the fixture corpus, ≥ 95% of interview turns contain a single question and 100% carry a recommendation (EVAL-1)
